thread:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — customer 'nimble-docs' just opened a Sev2. After rotating service key yesterday, their production ingest pipeline started returning empty generations. Embeddings still work.

Maya (CS): Customer repro steps they sent:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <PROD_SVC_KEY>\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-2.7b\",\"prompt\":\"Summarize this doc\",\"max_tokens\":64}'
```
Response body they see: `\{\"choices\":\[\{\"text\":\"\"\}\], \"request_id\": \"req_abc123\"\}` (HTTP 200). No error in app logs, customer assumes success but gets empty content.

Maya (CS): Separately their logs show a 403 when the service tries to call internal rerank endpoint: `/v1/rerank` -> `\{\"error\":\"permission_denied\",\"details\":\"missing scope: rerank\"\}`.

Oliver (Platform): So generate returns 200 empty but rerank is 403? That mismatch smells like SDK fallback behavior swallowing errors during generation and returning empty string when downstream pieces fail. Do we have audit logs for token scopes?

provisioner-bot: Provision check for key `svc_nimble_prod_01`: scopes = [\"embeddings\"], issued_at=2026-03-24T15:02:10Z (note: missing \"generation\" and \"rerank\").

Tess (Eng-ML): If the token only has embeddings, generate will be blocked — normally we'd return 403. But customer's app uses our official SDK which attempts a degraded path: it calls embeddings + an internal heuristic rerank when rerank scope present, otherwise tries a no-op rerank and ends up returning an empty string instead of surfacing the auth error. That's a bug in the SDK error flow.

Ben (Infra): Looking at provisioning service logs for the org import job that created that key: the CSV line for `nimble-docs` was `nimble-prod,embeddings,rerank,` with a trailing comma. Our parser splits on `,` and then trims; a trailing empty field triggers a path that accidentally drops the last non-empty scope due to an off-by-one in the normalizer. Result: only the first scope persisted (`embeddings`).

Ben (Infra): Repro in staging: created CSV `a,embeddings,rerank,\r\n` -> provisioned key with scopes [\"embeddings\"]. File bug/PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/provisioner/pull/1423 — patch normalizes CSV fields + strips empty trailing tokens. ETA for deploy: ~2h if CI passes.

Tess (Eng-ML): Short-term mitigation: we can patch SDK to fail loudly on missing generation/rerank permission instead of returning empty outputs. I can ship a hotfix to the Node/Python SDKs in the next release window (target 4h).

Oliver (Platform): Customer asked for an immediate unblock — options: 1) reissue a new key with correct scopes manually (CS can do now), 2) rollback the rotation (not ideal), 3) temp grant org-level key. Recommend issuing a new key and rotating in their app.

Maya (CS): I've told customer we'll issue a new key and follow up with a permanent fix. They requested audit log entries, timestamps, and the repro curl/response which I posted above. They also want confirmation once provisioner patch is deployed.

Ben (Infra): I'll deploy the patch to provisioner in ~90m and follow up here. After deploy, I'll re-run the import and revoke the bad keys created yesterday.

Tess (Eng-ML): I'll make an SDK PR to surface scope auth failures as errors and add a test for the empty-output case.

Maya (CS): Thanks all — escalated to account team, customer happy with new key plan. I'll paste the new key once it's created and mark this thread resolved when they confirm. :thumbsup:
